items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But there were times, in the words of Earl, the great drummer.

ctx.x: And he said that his father was afraid to turn down work, that he felt if he started turning down jobs that he, you know, would sink down on the list and consequently he just kept doing it until he couldn’t to it anymore. Did you ever feel like okay I did four sessions today, maybe I should not keep doing that?

Well rarely did I ever, I don’t think I ever did four sessions. The rhythm section guys did. They could work from morning until late at night. That was very, very rare with me. But there were times, in the words of Earl, the great drummer.
